```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Illustrative toy (not the paper's data). Two standardised characteristics, one per theme,
// with correlation rho; true coefficients 0.5 and 0.5; population ridge with penalty lambda.
// Copying the theme-X column k times with an identity penalty on the encoded coefficients
// is the same as penalising the canonical coefficient by lambda * b_x^2 / k (paper eq. 2).
// The transported control multiplies the copies' penalty back so the canonical penalty is unchanged.
viewof jmp_toy_k = Inputs.range([1, 10], { value: 1, step: 1, label: LANG === "zh" ? "主题 X 的份数 k（1 = 不复制）" : "Copies of theme X, k (1 = no copying)" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof jmp_toy_rho = Inputs.range([0, 0.9], { value: 0.5, step: 0.05, label: LANG === "zh" ? "两个主题的重叠程度（相关系数 ρ）" : "Overlap of the two themes (correlation ρ)" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof jmp_toy_lambda = Inputs.range([0.1, 4], { value: 1, step: 0.1, label: LANG === "zh" ? "惩罚强度 λ" : "Penalty strength λ" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
jmp_toy_beta = [0.5, 0.5]
jmp_toy_fit = (k, rho, lam) => {
  // b = (Sigma + lam * diag(1/k, 1))^{-1} Sigma beta, Sigma = [[1, rho], [rho, 1]]
  const a11 = 1 + lam / k, a12 = rho, a22 = 1 + lam
  const s1 = jmp_toy_beta[0] + rho * jmp_toy_beta[1], s2 = rho * jmp_toy_beta[0] + jmp_toy_beta[1]
  const det = a11 * a22 - a12 * a12
  const bx = (a22 * s1 - a12 * s2) / det, bz = (a11 * s2 - a12 * s1) / det
  const varU = bx * bx + bz * bz + 2 * rho * bx * bz
  const share = (bx * bx + rho * bx * bz) / varU
  const dx = jmp_toy_beta[0] - bx, dz = jmp_toy_beta[1] - bz
  const excess = dx * dx + dz * dz + 2 * rho * dx * dz
  return { bx, bz, share, excess }
}
jmp_toy_rows = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => i + 1).flatMap((k) => [
  { k, rule: LANG === "zh" ? "每份照常逐列惩罚" : "Ordinary penalty on each copy", share: 100 * jmp_toy_fit(k, jmp_toy_rho, jmp_toy_lambda).share },
  { k, rule: LANG === "zh" ? "换算惩罚（精确对照）" : "Penalty scaled back up (exact control)", share: 100 * jmp_toy_fit(1, jmp_toy_rho, jmp_toy_lambda).share }
])
jmp_toy_now = jmp_toy_fit(jmp_toy_k, jmp_toy_rho, jmp_toy_lambda)
jmp_toy_base = jmp_toy_fit(1, jmp_toy_rho, jmp_toy_lambda)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
jmp_toy_chart = Plot.plot({
  height: 280, marginLeft: 56, marginRight: 16, style: { fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: 12 },
  ariaLabel: LANG === "zh" ? "示意性示例：复制主题 X 时，主题 X 在拟合风险中的份额" : "Illustrative example: theme X's share of fitted risk as theme X is copied",
  ariaDescription: LANG === "zh"
    ? "两条线，横轴为主题 X 的份数 k（1 到 10）。每份照常逐列惩罚时，主题 X 的份额随 k 上升；把惩罚按份数加回去（换算惩罚）时，份额始终停在 50%。"
    : "Two lines against the number of copies from 1 to 10. With an ordinary penalty on each copy, theme X's share rises with k; with the penalty scaled back up, it stays at 50%.",
  x: { label: LANG === "zh" ? "主题 X 的份数 k" : "Copies of theme X (k)", domain: [1, 10], ticks: 10 },
  y: { label: LANG === "zh" ? "主题 X 在拟合风险中的份额（%）" : "Theme X's share of fitted risk (%)", domain: [0, 100], grid: true },
  color: { domain: jmp_toy_rows.slice(0, 2).map((d) => d.rule), range: [palette.naipca_iab, palette.rp_pca], legend: true },
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([50], { stroke: palette.rule }),
    Plot.line(jmp_toy_rows.filter((d, i) => i % 2 === 0), { x: "k", y: "share", stroke: "rule", strokeWidth: 2 }),
    Plot.line(jmp_toy_rows.filter((d, i) => i % 2 === 1), { x: "k", y: "share", stroke: "rule", strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "5 4" }),
    Plot.dot([{ k: jmp_toy_k, share: 100 * jmp_toy_now.share }], { x: "k", y: "share", r: 6, fill: palette.naipca_iab }),
    Plot.text([{ k: jmp_toy_k, share: 100 * jmp_toy_now.share }], { x: "k", y: "share", text: (d) => `${d.share.toFixed(0)}%`, dy: -14, fontWeight: 600 })
  ]
})
```
